TypeSafe AI | AI research & engineering | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE | Full-time

TypeSafe AI is a seed-stage AI company based in San Francisco. We're led by cofounder and CEO Diogo Almeida, formerly of OpenAI and Google Brain.

We're building a new class of reliable AI models that combine the intelligence of frontier LLMs with the speed and reliability of code.

We're hiring: -Developer Advocate -GPU Kernel Engineer -Infrastructure Engineer, Kubernetes Specialist -Member of Technical Staff, Synthetic Data (multiple needed) -Product Engineer -Senior Backend/Platform Engineer (multiple needed) -Founding Recruiter

All roles are fully in-office in San Francisco. We offer top-tier early-stage AI compensation, meaningful equity, full health benefits, and a 401(k).

Apply and see role details: https://typesafe.ai/careers
